title: Answer Question
description: The sub-orchestrator answers a worker question.

answer.description: The answer, in 1 of the 4 cases of the design.

case.description: Closed list from ledger questions.answer_case: covered (the approved assumptions or spec cover it), revise (goes to the operator), replan (the plan has a flaw), own_decision (a new reversible assumption).

text.description: The answer the worker resumes with, or the assumption text for own_decision.

citation.description: The approved line the answer cites, e.g. assumptions.md#2. Required when case is covered; fleetd checks that it exists.

idempotency_key.description: Opaque key that the horch CLI makes once per command run. The command channel request and the request file of the same run carry the same key. fleetd applies a request once per key and returns the first outcome again (orchestrator, D15).
